items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: whether it’s Louis Prima or Harry James or Bunny Berigan or whoever, or Roy Eldridge or Joe Thomas or all the guys that were influenced by Louis

ctx.x: I had a very ambivalent mother. In fact my wife and I bought “The Soprano” series, you know, on HBO, “The Sopranos” series. And it turns out that I really have something in common with Tony Soprano, you know, a/k/a James whatever his name is, he’s very good, that we both had the same mother. Same mother. In fact she even has the same voice.
